newsitem.title: POLAND: BUDIMEX TO ISSUE TWO MLN SHARES FOR MERGER.
newsitem.headline: BUDIMEX TO ISSUE TWO MLN SHARES FOR MERGER.

text.p: Polish construction company Budimex SA plans to issue two million registered, preferred shares for Budimex Trading SA shareholders to launch the merger of the firms, a Budimex official said on Wednesday.
Eugeniusz Trajer, the general director adviser, told Reuters the merger had to be approved by the firm's general shareholders meeting on February 25.
"There will be two million new shares issued for the merger," he said.
Budimex Trading's main shareholder is Kredyt Bank and the remaining 30 have stakes of below five percent.
Trajer said the merger would be carried out by taking all shares of Budimex Trading by Budimex SA in exchange for its new registered shares. He said Budimex Trading shares will later be retired.
Trajer said the new Budimex shares, which would be floated in the second half of 1997, would carry five voting rights each.
